name: Tune Advisor history on disarm
step: Check the Tune Advisor history on disarm
rationale:
The FC keeps its tune advisor statistics in RAM; the radio saves each
flight on disarm, clears the FC, and the page combines the last 5 flights
on the current tune. Pins the capture (one flight per disarm, then a
clear; 5 flights kept; a disarm during a link loss captured on reconnect;
firmware without the command asked once), its pacing and the aggregate
(only the newest tune, counts added, ratios weighted).

Each 65-byte reply takes about 15 S.Port/FBUS telemetry frames that would
otherwise carry sensors, and the FC sends no sensors for 250 ms after it.
Read back to back and retried every few seconds, the capture kept current
and ESC sensors off the radio after a disarm. The harness pins the wait
after the disarm and between requests, a failed axis asked again on its
own, at most three link errors per disarm, and three sends per read.
